stats.notes: Early decision counts are for the Fall 2025 class (ED I and ED II combined as reported). In-state means Massachusetts. 2,159 applicants, 349 admits and 97 enrollees have unknown residency, so they are not counted as in-state, out-of-state or international. Test-optional; only 36% of enrollees sent SAT scores and 10% sent ACT scores.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT/ACT not required for admission but considered if submitted. Test optional through fall 2028 and spring 2029 for all undergraduate schools and scholarship programs.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-2026). Other costs are $1,455 (other expenses); transportation ($630 for residents) is separate and not included. BU offers nonresident undergraduates its own non-need-based aid only (need-based aid is not available); the 231 recipients and the $56,639 average cover all nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates awarded need-based or non-need-based aid
